caption: Day 12 of 20 toddler lunch ideas 🤍 Mini tortilla quiche 💛 Ingredients:• 4 eggs• ½ cup cottage cheese• Cherry tomatoes• Baby spinach• Feta cheese• Mozzarella cheese• Tortillas Directions:Place tortilla circles into muffin pan → add spinach, tomatoes & feta → pour egg mixture → top with mozzarella → bake at 350°F / 180°C for 15–20 min ✨ Easy, balanced, and feels fancy without much effort 🤍 I love pairing iron-rich spinach with vitamin C from tomatoes to help support iron absorption 💛 👉 I use MunchMind because it has 200+ baby & toddler-approved recipes, weekly meal plans already planned for you, and grocery lists — so I don't have to think about what to cook every day 💛 Find it in my bio ✨ #toddlermeals #toddlerlunchideas #pickytoddler #toddlerrecipes #easyrecipe
